title: Ireblind Imp
summary: The Ireblind Imp releases groups of rage essences at three health thresholds.
overview: The Ireblind Imp releases groups of rage essences at three health thresholds.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for three essences at each of 76%, 51% and 26%.
Collect and control the essences before pushing into the next threshold.
Keep the imp tank covered while damage dealers manage each new group.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
